explanation.title: Hover for explanation
explanation.not_detected: No cognitive process has been detected. This does not mean you have done nothing. The action you performed could not be detected as a cognitive or metacognitive process.
explanation.orientation: Orientation is figuring out what the task is. This can be done using the general instruction, rubric, and menu.
explanation.planning: Planning is making a schedule of the task. This can be done using the planner.
explanation.monitoring: Monitoring is checking your learning. This can be done using the general instruction, notes, the planner, and the timer.
explanation.evaluation: Evaluation is checking the information in the text or essay. You can do this by comparing the information to the general instruction or rubric. Then you choose to continue with the same information or read or write something else.
explanation.reading: Reading is reading a text for the first time.
explanation.rereading: Rereading is reading a text again.
explanation.writing: Writing is the act of writing the essay.
explanation.organising: Note-taking is the taking or reading of notes.
explanation.copying: Copying is taking information from the source texts, this can be in your own words or exactly copied.
explanation.editing: Editing is making small changes in the text such as correcting a spelling mistake.
explanation.structuring: Structuring is adding structure to the text, for example by making a heading or moving text to another place.
explanation.expanding: Expanding is adding information that cannot be deduced from the source text.
